statements.impact_statement: CMS_encrypt and CMS_encrypt_ex can loop forever with an EC recipient certificate whose group order is 1. Alpine fixed this in openssl 3.5.9-r1 (listed under 3.5.9-r1 in the Alpine v3.24 secdb) by backporting the patch. Grype only has the NVD CPE range (< 3.5.10) for this package, so it flags the patched revision. Only Alpine openssl, libssl3 and libcrypto3 3.5.9-r1 are covered; no other revision is. Remove this document (and its vex-documents entry) when the Dockerfile pin reaches an upstream release at or above the NVD fixed version or Grype reads the Alpine fix.
